svg.title: Three Core Seats, Two Capacity-Triggered Additions
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-06-core-and-scaled-pod; chart type: org_architecture; title: Three Core Seats, Two Capacity-Triggered Additions; subtitle: Base economics use 1 FT + 2 C; scaled economics use 2 FT + 3 C.; chapter number: 11; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: FT means full-time seat; C means contractor seat. The first three roles form the core pod. Add the fourth and fifth only for the five-person scaled configuration; do not attribute scaled output to the unchanged three-person team.; caption: Automation supports pricing, listing synchronization, barcode transfer, and invoice matching. Named operators still own exception handling and cash reconciliation.; stages: label: Owner and inventory principal; value: Core full-time seat; cumulative one; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Own acquisition limits, supplier rights, event exposure, dynamic drop-curve pricing, and playoff-probability inputs. Set position size from available settlement liquidity rather than headline inventory markups.; label: POS and transfer operator; value: Core contractor seat; cumulative two; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Manage SkyBox, Automatiq, or Logitix exceptions, hold acknowledgments, barcode transfers, and emergency channel suspension. Reconcile sold inventory against delivery evidence before marking orders complete.; label: Corporate sales coordinator; value: Core contractor seat; cumulative three; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Qualify corporate buyers, assemble documented package offers, collect authorized deposits, and reconcile B2B suite invoices. Keep promised access and hospitality services aligned with supplier entitlements.; label: Settlement and event controller; value: Scaled full-time seat; cumulative four; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Own daily cash forecasting, exchange-statement matching, refund exposure, reserve sizing, and event-level profit close. Separate bank reconciliation from the operator initiating inventory purchases.; label: Event fulfillment coordinator; value: Scaled contractor seat; cumulative five; numeric value: 5.0; detail: Handle event-day access exceptions, supplier confirmations, group manifests, and service-delivery evidence. Escalate missing entitlements before entry time instead of substituting undocumented benefits.

text.title: Three Core Seats, Two Capacity-Triggered Additions

circle.title: label: Owner and inventory principal; value: Core full-time seat; cumulative one; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Own acquisition limits, supplier rights, event exposure, dynamic drop-curve pricing, and playoff-probability inputs. Set position size from available settlement liquidity rather than headline inventory markups.

text.title: Own acquisition limits, supplier rights, event exposure, dynamic drop-curve pricing, and playoff-probability inputs. Set position size from available settlement liquidity rather than headline inventory markups.

circle.title: label: POS and transfer operator; value: Core contractor seat; cumulative two; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Manage SkyBox, Automatiq, or Logitix exceptions, hold acknowledgments, barcode transfers, and emergency channel suspension. Reconcile sold inventory against delivery evidence before marking orders complete.

text.title: Manage SkyBox, Automatiq, or Logitix exceptions, hold acknowledgments, barcode transfers, and emergency channel suspension. Reconcile sold inventory against delivery evidence before marking orders complete.

Keep promised access and hospitality services aligned with supplier entitlements.

text.title: Qualify corporate buyers, assemble documented package offers, collect authorized deposits, and reconcile B2B suite invoices. Keep promised access and hospitality services aligned with supplier entitlements.

Separate bank reconciliation from the operator initiating inventory purchases.

text.title: Handle event-day access exceptions, supplier confirmations, group manifests, and service-delivery evidence. Escalate missing entitlements before entry time instead of substituting undocumented benefits.

Assumptions: FT means full-time seat; C means contractor seat. The first three roles form the core pod. Add the fourth and fifth only for the five-person scaled configuration; do not attribute scaled output to the unchanged three-person team.
